checks.scope: Restriction v=(s,0) of a_t(|v|-Gamma), at s=0. Unequal one-sided derivatives disprove automatic differentiability in the gradient variable. Special parameter cancellations are not ruled out by this example.

checks.name: Scaling identity spot checks
checks.scope: Finite arithmetic cross-check only. The all-value identity a(lambda*q;lambda*epsilon)=lambda*a(q;epsilon) follows algebraically and is proved in the report.
